definitions.explanation: A language expressed with the hands, face and body, used mainly by deaf people.

examples.japanese: {手話|しゅわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手話|しゅわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}していた→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: The two were talking in sign language.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手話通訳者|しゅわつうやくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: At press conferences, sign language interpreters now often stand next to the speaker.

notes:
Sign languages are full languages, not a signed form of the spoken language; Japanese Sign Language has its own grammar.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手話|しゅわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk in sign language
- {手話通訳|しゅわつうやく}: sign language interpretation
- {手話|しゅわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to be able to sign

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{聴覚障害|ちょうかくしょうがい}→聴覚障害：24829_choukakushougai⟧: hearing impairment
- ⟦{筆談|ひつだん}→筆談：33517_hitsudan⟧: communicating in writing
